name: whole_scene_severe_damage_specialist
purpose: Test whether a fixed whole-scene specialist can recover major obvious physical damage missed by Detector v3 without excessive false positives.

methodology.input_frames: reuse existing OpenCV-selected keyframes from the completed Step 44 run
methodology.selection_policy: Run the identical specialist policy on every one of the 14 cases; do not target only known false negatives.
target_scope: major missing or collapsed ceiling/roof material
exposed structural framing caused by visible damage
large-scale broken or deteriorated wall/ceiling surfaces
major debris or destroyed interior material
severe soot/char-like or burn-related visible deterioration
other clearly severe physical property damage
reject_scope: cause inference when only damage is visually supported
methodology.promotion_rule: Research evidence only. Arm A is not automatically adopted into Detector v4 regardless of result.
